candidate_change: Move the first SUM/AVG native aggregate input into its accumulator only when same-query ownership, exact fresh-copy capacities and field identity match the existing copy. Share the unchanged final-endpoint field-identity predicate.

rejection.decision: Reject under frozen target and individual timing gates; restore five owned Rust files. No retries or threshold relaxation.
rejection.cause: The cause of the profile-dependent and individual slowdowns is unproven; reduced allocation traffic does not establish faster complete queries.

resources.memory: All current/peak/acquired/released fields nonincreasing, without overflow. Every target reduces Workspace allocation traffic in every panel.
resources.other_observations: Work and cancellation-reference counters nonincrease. Every other nonelapsed observation exactly equal, including reads, output and temporary storage. All timing pairs also checked, including warmups.
resources.scope: Cumulative allocation savings are not peak savings. Query-accounted memory is not RSS; category peaks are not additive.

plan.acceptance: Exact complete results; no memory category current/peak/acquired/released growth; target allocation traffic reduced; work and cancellation references may decrease with eliminated copies, physical reads/output/temporary storage unchanged. Targetmedians<=.98,controls<=1.05,onefollowupforindividual>1.05. No cap or raw-history change.

limitations: No full native, ARM, C/C++, static or default compiled-size qualification after early rejection. Prepared C sources are not executed evidence.
Candidate-v2 only adds a successful later-growth unit test; production source is identical to candidate. The 45 focused checks span these two phases, not one complete suite.
Fresh original empty mixed-type group outcomes are explicit controls, not successful nonempty feature coverage.
Finite synthetic timings do not establish universal, concurrent, live-provider or physical ARM performance.
